blocks.text: The market entry assessment for {{fact:f:E-2012-001.client}} is on track, and we are about a quarter of the way through. The market data is in hand and the benchmark set is largely built. Deborah Gordon has finished the first pass on the demand read, and the early signal looks consistent with what we heard at kickoff. The next step is a working session to take you through the findings so far.

One item is outstanding on your side. We still need the regional sales breakdown your finance team agreed to send. Deborah Gordon needs it to close the segment comparison, and without it we would be presenting around a gap. If you can have it to me by the middle of next week, we can hold the session as planned and keep the review on its timeline.

For the session, our attendees will be Jason Torres, Deborah Gordon, and James Green, with you, Mark Villegas, and whoever on your side owns the sales figures. Jason Torres will lead it and take you through the read. Let me know a day next week that suits you, and I will hold it and send an agenda round once the date is fixed.
